description: Destruction and dissolution — controlled dismantling of stale patterns, context purging, assumption clearing, and dead-code elimination. Maps Shiva's transformative destruction to AI reasoning: identifying what must end so something better can begin, dissolving attachment to outdated approaches, and creating space through intentional release. Use when context has accumulated stale assumptions, when a failed approach needs to be discarded rather than patched, when dead code or zombie tasks are creating noise, or before a major pivot where clearing must precede creation.
